results: 1. Comprehensive physical examination including vital signs, HEENT, neck, cardiovascular, respiratory, abdominal, musculoskeletal, neurological, and skin examination
mental status / cognitive screen: mild cognitive impairment
muscle tone examination: increased tone with rigidity
coordination examination (limb and truncal): mild limb and truncal ataxia
posture and pull test: impaired postural stability with abnormal pull test
limb power and wasting: normal bulk and power
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
liver function tests: mildly raised transaminases with reduced albumin
vitamin B12 with methylmalonic acid: normal
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Wilson's disease (hepatolenticular degeneration) — autosomal recessive ATP7B copper-transport defect.

- Acquired (non-Wilsonian) hepatocerebral degeneration
- Early-onset atypical parkinsonism / multiple system atrophy
- Hereditary ataxia with incidental hepatic dysfunction
